subject: Discrepancy and double charge on Invoice #INV-2026-9041
body:
Hi Acme Billing,

We noticed that our credit card ending in 4109 was charged twice for $1,450 on October 1st for the annual Pro subscription renewal. We should have only been billed once.

Could you please investigate this duplicate charge and issue a prompt refund for the second transaction?

Attached is our credit card statement screenshot.

Thank you,
Sarah Lin
Controller, Zenith Studio
